house.title: A small housing question
house.note: A visitor asks Abraham to stay. The directory is my addition.

bread.title: You saved something
bread.note: The stars become the measure of Abraham’s descendants.

offering.title: About the rent
offering.note: El Shaddai promises descendants and land. Borrowing money is my addition.

inspect.title: I came down to look
inspect.note: YHWH goes down to investigate the report about Sodom.

seed.title: An update from the land department
seed.note: The promise of land to Abraham’s descendants.

covenant.title: Long-term support
covenant.note: An everlasting covenant. The hundred-year support plan is my addition.

merch.title: A house. Or a shirt.
merch.note: The visitor asks Abraham to let him stay. The shirts are YHWH’s idea.
